# stage-gates

Purpose: Define explicit per-stage gates and acceptance checklists before any modeling, render, or export work — work only proceeds gate by gate.

Enforce a checklist-driven discipline where every stage of a Blender recipe (brief → asset → scene → render → export → handoff) has a written acceptance gate. Work does not advance until the previous stage's gate is checked off. Inspired by Anthropic Superpowers `/test-driven-development` analog: gate first, work second.

Metadata: Contract `v1.0.0` | Category `process-discipline` | Role `stage-gate-checklist-enforcer` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- complex multi-stage recipe (4+ distinct stages) requiring per-stage gate enforcement
- when work must be locked behind explicit `Pending | Pass | Fail | Blocked` stage gates before advancing
- when the user wants verifiable proof that each stage passes its checks before starting the next stage
- before any runtime work begins, to lock concrete checks, required evidence, and failure exits per stage
- Trigger phrases: "let's do this step by step", "what's done before we move on", "checklist for this work", "I want to make sure each stage is solid"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- single-step requests → use `blender-brainstorming` (`references/skill-blender-brainstorming.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blender-brainstorming)
- pure exploratory brainstorming → use `blender-brainstorming` (`references/skill-blender-brainstorming.md`; use blender-brainstorming)
- decomposing a brief into stages → use `blender-recipe-decomposer` (`references/skill-blender-recipe-decomposer.md`; use blender-recipe-decomposer)
- writing measurable acceptance criteria rows from scratch → use `acceptance-criteria-builder` (`references/skill-acceptance-criteria-builder.md`; use acceptance-criteria-builder)
- pinning the overall done/stop condition → use `done-criteria` (`references/skill-done-criteria.md`; use done-criteria)
- guarding against mid-flight scope creep → use `scope-guard` (`references/skill-scope-guard.md`; use scope-guard)
- selecting which skill runs next across the workflow → use `workflow-stage-router` (`references/skill-workflow-stage-router.md`; use workflow-stage-router)
- fixing repeated stage failures or broken renders → use `blender-troubleshooting` (`references/skill-blender-troubleshooting.md`; use blender-troubleshooting)
- executing the final 7-point handoff gate → use `pre-handoff-verification` (`references/skill-pre-handoff-verification.md`; use pre-handoff-verification)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `active_workflow_stages` (`array`): Ordered stages of the selected BlendOps recipe or custom workflow
- Required input `locked_acceptance_criteria` (`object`): Measurable acceptance rows from acceptance-criteria-builder
- Optional input `current_stage_status` (`string`): Current stage progress and completed gate checks
- Output contract: `stage_gate_checklists`, `entry_and_exit_preconditions`, `gate_failure_routing_rules` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. list the stages of the user's recipe
2. write the gate per stage (specific, checkable conditions)
3. run the gate after each stage; do not proceed if it fails
4. record the gate result + evidence per stage

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: Process / discipline skill — does not run Blender. Gates are written and evaluated against produced artifacts (per `evidence-before-done.md`). Gate verdicts are honest labels, not motivation.
- Run Blender or execute Python.
- Decompose recipes into stages (`blender-recipe-decomposer`).
- Write measurable acceptance criteria rows (`acceptance-criteria-builder`).
- Pin the overall done/stop condition (`done-criteria`).
- Guard against scope creep (`scope-guard`).
- Pick next skills across the workflow (`workflow-stage-router`).
- Diagnose repeated technical failures (`blender-troubleshooting`).
- Replace the final 7-point handoff gate (`pre-handoff-verification`).
